summary: Iteration 7 RETEST of the iteration_6 issues plus a quick regression. BACKEND: 6 of 8 new pytest pass (test_iteration7_retest.py). FRONTEND (390x844): every requested customer-app item passes. The only item that is NOT FIXED is the admin web panel logins: both forms are still prefilled with credentials. PASSES: (1) Silver Rs1000 bought from the Home BuyWidget at Rs92.39/g. The preview showed 10.8236g and 10.8236g was credited, so preview and credit match with floor to 4 decimals. The passbook row reads 'Silver Purchase +10.8236g' in green. The passbook 'Buy' filter returns 6 rows, both silver and gold. The silver invoice shows Type 'Silver Purchase', 'Silver (999)' and 'Silver value'. (2) The Vault card shows 'Silver in vault: 21.5624g'. Profile shows 'Gold balance 0.6550g' and 'Silver balance 21.5624g'. (3) The Jewellery ticker shows '24K (99.9%) ₹7,291.81/g ▲ INDICATIVE' with no truncation; scrollWidth equals clientWidth for every text. (4) gift-name-input is 52px tall. (5) The silver confirm sheet note reads 'Silver is credited to your vault instantly'. (6) Gold Rs500 previewed 0.0686g and credited 0.0686g. The backend test confirms r4 floor matches the preview for both gold and silver. (7) The 'dropped below' banner showed while change_pct was negative (▼0.12%). The code returns null when change_pct >= 0 (PriceAlert.tsx:16); the positive case could not be forced live. (8) /products with no jeweller_id returns only products of active jewellers. Suspending Patel removed its products from the list; Patel was restored afterwards. (9) Admin logins work in the API and the browser: admin/admin123 and sharma@vaultra.in/jeweller123 both reach the dashboard. FAIL: both admin login forms are still prefilled. Regression: OTP login (Meera) and gold buy both pass. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: The login form is still prefilled. backend/templates/master_admin.html:148-149 has value="admin" on #lu and value="admin123" on #lp.

The login form is still prefilled when no tenant domain is set. backend/templates/jeweller_admin.html:177-178 has value="${tenant ? '' : 'sharma@vaultra.in'}" and 'jeweller123'. On the preview URL, tenant is always null, so the credentials are always shown.
